i.norm:
The character sequence used by the original generated test. It is an arbitrary string in which every visible character is immediately followed by a NUL ('�') character, e.g. '[' , NUL , 'N' , NUL , ... , 'W' , NUL.

It is built here from plain ASCII source (a visible character plus an explicit NUL) so the test file contains no embedded control characters, while the resulting runtime string is identical to the literal in the original test.

Verifies that {@link StringUtils#equals(CharSequence, CharSequence)} returns {@code true} when comparing a {@code String} against a {@code CharBuffer} that wraps the exact same characters.

Because the two arguments are different CharSequence implementations (not both {@code String}s), {@code equals} falls back to a length plus per-region character comparison, which still reports them as equal.
